description: This file implements the PathOutput class, which handles outputting file and directory paths with various formatting options, including escaping and relative path handling, for a build system or similar project.

classes.name: PathOutput
classes.description: A class responsible for outputting file and directory paths with proper escaping and formatting, used in build path generation.

methods.name: PathOutput::PathOutput
methods.description: Constructor initializing PathOutput with current directory, source root, and escaping mode.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Outputs a source file path to the stream.

methods.name: WriteDir
methods.description: Outputs a directory path with specified slash ending formatting.

methods.name: WriteFiles
methods.description: Outputs multiple files (SourceFile, OutputFile, or UniqueVector of OutputFile).

methods.name: WriteDir
methods.description: Outputs a directory path from an OutputFile with slash formatting.

methods.name: WriteSourceRelativeString
methods.description: Outputs a string relative to the source directory, with escaping.

methods.name: WritePathStr
methods.description: Outputs a path string, handling prefix trimming and absolute path formatting.
